svg.title: Chronic liver failure: find the cause (alcohol, primary sclerosing cholangitis, primary biliary cholangitis among others) and manage the complications of cirrhosis (varices by size and risk, ascites, hepatic encephalopathy), each with presentation, investigations and treatment in order

svg.text: failure = synthesis ↓ (albumin, clotting factors) + excretion ↓ (bilirubin, jaundice)

svg.text: a MASS in chronic liver disease = hepatocellular carcinoma until proven otherwise
